transcribed_question: What structure is related to the area marked GREEN

marker.description: Green paint applied to the base of the spinous process

main_question: What structure is related to the area marked GREEN?
main_explanation: The green paint is applied to the posterior projection of the vertebral arch, which is the spinous process. This structure serves as an attachment point for muscles and ligaments.

supporting_question.question: Which ligament attaches to the tip of the structure indicated?
supporting_question.explanation: The supraspinous ligament connects the tips of the spinous processes of the vertebrae.
